params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: The daily worklist mail tells a garage "1 transport dat op je wacht" while its transport overview says there is nothing to do. The count includes transports that no longer wait for the garage, such as a delivered one, so the mail keeps sending people to an empty page.

## What happens

A garage gets the daily mail ("<garage>: 2 dingen wachten op je") with one untreated lead and one waiting transport. The transport overview of that account has nothing open: its own transports there are one delivered (`completed`, "Afgehandeld") and one cancelled. The transport line comes back in every mail.

The garage also noticed that it only gets the mail on days with a lead or a Car-Pass to renew. That part is the documented rule (R P1-2.12: a dealer with only open transports is not selected) and is not changed here.

## Why

`Dealer::OpenTransport`, which the mail counts, and `WidgetService::get5Data`, the transport worklist, both take every transport that is not `paid`, `cancelled` or `price_requested` (R P1-2.8). That rule is older than the planning states: `transport_requested`, `pickup_confirmed` and `completed` came after it and were never excluded. So a transport that is in planning, or delivered long ago, still counts as waiting for the garage.

The transport overview already knows which states wait for the garage: its folded "wait" section is `pending`, `price_available`, `price_received` and `waiting_payment`. Everything after that is the office's to do.

## Proposed fix

One named set of states on `Transport` (`WAITING_FOR_GARAGE_STATES`), used by the mail, the worklist widget and the overview's "wait" section, so the three cannot drift apart again. Update R P1-2.8 to match.

Source: Portal mail:44.
params.title: Daily mail counts a delivered or planned transport as waiting for the garage
